title: Coefficientwise pullback data for a quasi-coherent graded algebra
statement: Let $g:X\prime\to X$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], and let $\mathcal A$ and $\mathcal B$ be quasi-coherent graded algebras on $X$ and $X\prime$, respectively, in the affine-basis presentation of [def-nagata-relative-proj]. An identification of $\mathcal B$ with the coefficientwise pullback $g^*\mathcal A$ [def-pc-module-pullback] consists, for every pair of affine opens $U\subseteq X$, $U\prime\subseteq X\prime$ with $U\prime\subseteq g^{-1}(U)$, of a degree-preserving ring map $\alpha_{U,U\prime}:\mathcal A(U)\to\mathcal B(U\prime)$ over the structure-ring map $g^\sharp_{U,U\prime}$. In every degree $n\geq0$, the induced semilinear map exhibits $\mathcal B(U\prime)_n$ as $\mathcal O_{X\prime}(U\prime)\otimes_{\mathcal O_X(U)}\mathcal A(U)_n$, with the canonical tensor map $s\otimes a\mapsto s\alpha_{U,U\prime}(a)$. The maps commute with restriction in both $U$ and $U\prime$. These are algebra identifications, including the unit and multiplication, not merely unrelated isomorphisms of the underlying modules. There is no flatness assumption.
